name: Melinio

seo.title: Focus on Modern Food | Melinio
seo.description: Savor the authentic flavors at Melinio. We invite you to experience our homemade modern food without compromising on taste or quality. Loved by creators and pro

items.title: Wood-Fired Black Truffle & Porcini Risotto
items.fullDescription: Crafted with master Italian culinary precision.
items.shortDescription: Acquerello carnaroli rice simmered with wild porcini, parmigiano reggiano 24-month, and shaved black truffles.

items.title: 45-Day Dry-Aged Prime Bone-In Ribeye (16 oz)
items.fullDescription: Aged in our Himalayan salt locker for 45 full days to concentrate deep umami flavors.
items.shortDescription: Charred over white oak and Japanese binchotan charcoal. Finished with roasted bone marrow butter and sea salt.

items.title: Handmade Saffron Tagliolini with Langoustines
items.fullDescription: Hand-rolled fresh every morning in our open pasta kitchen.
items.shortDescription: Golden egg pasta infused with Greek red saffron, sweet Mediterranean langoustines, and Meyer lemon butter.

items.title: Pan-Seared Chilean Sea Bass with Miso Glaze
items.fullDescription: Melt-in-your-mouth Chilean sea bass marinated for 72 hours in traditional Kyoto white miso.
items.shortDescription: Wild-caught fillet caramelized in saikyo sweet white miso, baby bok choy, and dashi reduction.

items.title: 36-Hour Fermented Country Sourdough Loaf
items.fullDescription: Baked in our stone hearth oven at dawn.
items.shortDescription: Stone-milled heritage grain, wild sourdough culture, blistered deep crust, and airy custard crumb.

items.title: Reserve Black Truffle Carpaccio & Cold-Pressed EVOO
items.fullDescription: An indispensable pantry delicacy for finishing fresh pastas, roasted meats, and artisanal focaccia.
items.shortDescription: Hand-sliced Italian winter black truffles preserved in monocultivar Taggiasca extra virgin olive oil.

items.title: Valrhona Grand Cru Dark Chocolate Soufflé
items.fullDescription: Baked to order with an airy exterior and luscious molten chocolate center.
items.shortDescription: Warm molten Valrhona Guanaja 70% dark chocolate soufflé served with Tahitian vanilla bean creme anglaise.

items.title: Heritage Artisanal Charcuterie & Cheese Tasting Board
items.fullDescription: The quintessential beginning to an unforgettable meal.
items.shortDescription: Prosciutto di Parma 24-month, salame finocchiona, aged Comté, raw milk goat cheese, and honeycomb.

items.title: Burrata Caprese with San Marzano Heirloom Tomatoes
items.fullDescription: Simple perfection using only peak-season ingredients. Served at room temperature with warm focaccia.
items.shortDescription: Hand-stretched Puglia burrata, rooftop-grown heirloom tomatoes, aged 25-year balsamic, and Sicilian basil oil.

items.title: Roasted Duck Breast with Cherry & Foie Gras Jus
items.fullDescription: Scored and rendered to a glass-like crisp skin, finished oven-rested for a blush pink interior.
items.shortDescription: Slow-rendered Moulard duck breast with Morello cherry gastrique, sautéed spinach, and black truffle polenta.

items.title: House-Smoked Burgers & Truffle Parmesan Frites
items.fullDescription: Cold-smoked over mesquite chips for 2 hours before griddle-searing. Served on a brioche bun with truffle-scented parmesan frites.
items.shortDescription: Smoked 8oz short-rib blend patty, aged cheddar, caramelized onion jam, and house-smoked aioli.

items.title: Single-Origin Cold Brew Coffee Concentrate
items.fullDescription: Dilute 1:2 for glass-poured iced coffee or enjoy as-is over ice for an intense espresso-like experience.
items.shortDescription: Ethiopian Yirgacheffe Gr.1 coffee steeped 22 hours in filtered water. Smooth, low-acid, and naturally sweet.

items.title: Hand-Rolled Cinnamon Cardamom Morning Buns
items.fullDescription: Proofed overnight in our cold room and baked at dawn for maximum caramelization and flaky layers.
items.shortDescription: Laminated Viennoiserie dough layered with Ceylon cinnamon, green cardamom, and raw turbinado sugar.

items.title: Lobster Bisque with Cognac & Crème Fraîche
items.fullDescription: Slow-reduced lobster shells and aromatics create a deeply savory, velvety base with generous chunks of claw meat.
items.shortDescription: Rich Maine lobster bisque finished with aged cognac, house crème fraîche, and chervil.

items.title: Seasonal Tasting Menu (5 Courses)
items.fullDescription: A curated journey through the season's finest produce, composed daily by our chef and pastry team.
items.shortDescription: Five courses featuring amuse-bouche, crudo, pasta, main, and petit four dessert selection. Wine pairing available.

items.title: House Signature Negroni Cocktail
items.fullDescription: Our bar director's take on the classic: rested 30 days in American oak to mellow the bitterness and amplify caramel notes.
items.shortDescription: Barrel-aged gin, Campari, house sweet vermouth, and a hand-expressed orange coin over a single large ice sphere.
